verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway exposes a provider-agnostic proxy API and centralizes credentials so client code is 'shielded from AI Provider API specifics,' which aligns with pointing existing OpenAI-style calls at a new base URL/key. However, the docs show that using it requires first creating AI Model Provider/Model entities (e.g., for Anthropic) rather than a pure client-side base-URL/key swap, and no evidence explicitly confirms an OpenAI-compatible endpoint spec matching official OpenAI SDK behavior. Missing for 10: explicit OpenAI-compatible endpoint documentation, confirmation that zero server-side config beyond base URL/key change is needed, independent developer corroboration of drop-in compatibility.
